hooks.command: o=$(python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/check-staleness.py" 2>&1 || true); printf "%s\n" "$o" > "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.staleness-report.txt"; s=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -E "^(STALE VALUES STILL LIVE|BOM INTEGRITY|PASS|FAIL)" | head -3 | tr "\n" "; "); jq -n --arg s "$s" '{systemMessage: ("staleness: " + $s), hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse", additionalContext:("staleness check: " + $s + " Full list in .staleness-report.txt - read it when fixing, do not re-run for detail.")}}'
